They decks with ventilation built in that could be converted to cooling servers rather than cattle fairly easily, and they're already built and floating about. Move 'em, outfit them, bring them on line in less time than one of these bespoke ships. Since no one has, I'm sure that the idea lacks merit. No proof of concept equals to no one wants one IMO. This is a solution (revenue for shipyards) in search of a problem (vapor)
